physics_goals.value: Study the spatial structure of atomic nuclei and nuclear building blocks with electron scattering and magnetic spectrometers

summary.plain: A1 is an electron-scattering collaboration at Mainz with three large magnetic spectrometers, each about 15 metres long, that measure the particles from electron collisions with nuclei and nucleons with very high precision, for example the proton's form factors.
summary.technical: A1 Collaboration at MAMI: three-spectrometer facility (each >200 t, momentum resolution better than 1e-4) with vertical drift chambers, scintillators, Cherenkov counters, a focal-plane polarimeter and the KAOS spectrometer for kaons, studying nuclear and nucleon structure by electron scattering up to 1.5 GeV; precision proton form factors from about 1400 cross sections.
